sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 528 Bnss No. - 27932 of 2025
Applicant :- Ahmad Husain

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Hasan Parvej
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.
1.

Sri Hasan Parvej, learned counsel for the applicant seeks to withdraw the present application, in which challenge has been raised for quashing the impugned summoning order dated 18.02.2025 and as well as entire proceeding of pending Case No.1171 of 2025, State vs. Ahmad Husain, under sections 26(2)(i) / 59 (i) Food Safety and Standards Act 2006, Police Station Pooranpur, District Pilibhit, pending before the learned court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-First.

Pilibhit,
U.P., on account of technical inherent defect, with liberty to file afresh.
2. Learned A.G.A. has no objection to the same.
3. Accordingly, the application is dismissed as withdrawn, with the aforesaid liberty.
4. Office to return the certified copy to learned counsel for the applicant subject to furnishing a photocopy of the same.
